whyUseful.title: Why Modern Institutions Choose ShelfMaster
whyUseful.subtitle: Replacing prohibitively expensive cloud SaaS and outdated legacy software.

items.title: Unmatched Speed
items.desc: Because the database lives locally on the user's machine in SQLite WAL mode, searching for any book or member takes milliseconds.

items.title: Data Sovereignty
items.desc: Libraries own 100% of their data locally. Information is never stored on vulnerable or monitored third-party cloud servers.

items.title: All-in-One Operations Hub
items.desc: Doesn't just manage books—handles staff payroll, operational expenses, and philanthropic donations, eliminating separate accounting software.

items.title: Modern & Intuitive UX
items.desc: A sleek interface with a gentle learning curve ensures staff and volunteers master the system in minutes, not weeks.

modules.title: The 9 Built Core Modules
modules.subtitle: Engineered directly into a lightweight desktop binary with zero third-party dependencies.

items.title: Real-Time Command Dashboard
items.desc: Central command center displaying live active member counts, total cataloged books, overdue loans, and quick-access operational action buttons.

items.title: POS Circulation Desk
items.desc: The heart of the library. Issue books via Member Code and Barcode, process returns, and automatically calculate overdue fines ($0.50/day default rate).

items.title: Inventory Catalog
items.desc: Full book inventory management. Add books, categorize editions, and automatically generate unique sequential barcodes (e.g. BK-001).

items.title: Patron Directory & KYC
items.desc: Register patrons with auto-generated Member IDs (MBR-TIMESTAMP). View colored status badges to instantly identify active vs. expired memberships.

items.title: Donors & Gift Registry
items.desc: A dual-tab system to register philanthropic Donors and track their specific book or monetary donations over time.

items.title: Staff & Roster Directory
items.desc: Employee management module to track library staff members, maintain contact info, and monitor active staff status.

items.title: Automated Payroll Engine
items.desc: Generate dynamic payslips. Automatically calculates net pay (Base + Bonus - Deductions) and marks monthly salaries as paid.

items.title: Expenses & Financial Tracking
items.desc: Track daily operational expenses (utilities, maintenance, supplies) with monthly/yearly financial summary progress bars.

items.title: Settings & Policy Reports
items.desc: Configure library name & address, globally adjust loan policies (default loan days, fine rates), and view visual progress bars of popular books.

licensing.title: Security, Licensing, and License Key Management
licensing.subtitle: Enterprise-grade protection powered by Lemon Squeezy integration.

features.title: 16-Character License Key Workflow
features.desc: When customers purchase ShelfMaster, they receive a 16-character key. Upon initial app launch, a secure Activation Screen prompts key entry.

features.title: Rust-Backed API Security
features.desc: The application securely connects to the Lemon Squeezy API via our Rust backend—making it virtually impossible to bypass activation.

features.title: Hardware-Bound Device Management
features.desc: Licenses are tied to specific computer hardware. Installing on a new machine requires deactivating the previous device, preventing unauthorized piracy.

userGuide.title: End-User Guide: Getting Started with ShelfMaster
userGuide.subtitle: Install the software and get your library operational in under 5 minutes.

steps: Download the Installer: After purchasing, download ShelfMaster.dmg for Mac or ShelfMaster-Setup.exe for Windows.
Install on Mac: Double-click the .dmg file and drag the ShelfMaster icon into your Applications folder.
Install on Windows: Double-click the .exe file and follow the on-screen installation wizard.
Activate: Launch ShelfMaster. Paste your 16-character License Key into the Activation Screen and click 'Activate' (Internet connection required for activation step only).
Configure Settings: Click Settings in the bottom left of the sidebar.
Enter your Library Name and Address.
Set Loan Policy: Scroll to Loan Policy. Set standard loan duration (e.g. 14 days) and overdue fine rate (e.g. $0.50 per day). Click Save.

parts.part: Part 3: Adding Your First Book & Member
steps: Add a Book: Go to the Catalog tab and click '+ Add Book'. Enter Title, Author, and copy count. Click Save to auto-generate barcodes (e.g. BK-001).
Add a Member: Go to the Members tab and click '+ Add Member'. Fill out name and contact info to auto-generate a unique Member ID (MBR-TIMESTAMP).
Issue a Book: Navigate to the Circulation tab and click 'Issue Book'.
Enter Member ID and Book Barcode. Due date is set automatically based on loan policy settings. Click Issue.
Return a Book: When returned, locate the loan in the Active Loans list and click Return. ShelfMaster automatically calculates and displays overdue fines if late!
